text: DATA MANAGEMENT AND SHARING PLAN

label: section
text: Element 1: Data Type:

label: subsection
text: A. Types and amount of scientific data expected to be generated in the project:

label: content
text: This secondary data analysis project will analyze deidentified data from 48,218 participants from eight studies

label: content
text: and the publicly available NHANES cohorts (wrist NHANES 2011-2014; hip/counts-NHANES 2003-2006).

label: content
text: The studies include (i) the RISE Study, (ii) the SOL-VIDA Study, (iii) the iWATCH Study, (iv) the MOCA Study,

label: content
text: (v) the PHASE Study, (vi) the AusDiab Study, (vii) the ACT Study, and (viii) the WHISH accelerometer sub-

label: content
text: study.

label: subsection
text: B. Scientific data that will be preserved and shared, and the rationale for doing so:

label: content
text: As this is a secondary data analysis project, we will only be able to publicly share in the UC San Diego Library

label: content
text: Repository sitting behavior metrics or analysis that were created in this project from the following UCSD-

label: content
text: based study datasets:

label: content
text: (i) The RISE study

label: content
text: Sufficient data from those datasets will be preserved to enable sharing to validate and replicate research

label: content
text: findings described in the Aims with those datasets only. Please see Element 5 for data access information

label: subsection
text: C. Metadata, other relevant data, and associated documentation:

label: content
text: In addition to the data described above, code and models will be included in the repository and in on our

label: content
text: project’s GitHub website, hosted as part of the UCSD Advance Data Analytics Lab GitHub and titled “Deep

label: content
text: Postures”.

label: section
text: Element 2: Related Tools, Software and/or Code:

label: content
text: Data will be analyzed with custom code by our statistical and computer science team. ActiGraph data will be

label: content
text: processed and analyzed using ActiLife software which requires a paid license. All custom code and models

label: content
text: will also be shared in the data repository and on our project’s GitHub website, hosted as part of the UCSD

label: content
text: Advance Data Analytics Lab GitHub and titled “Deep Postures”.

label: section
text: Element 3: Standards:

label: content
text: The following data will be created as a result of this project:

label: content
text: Objective sedentary behavior metrics – no existing standards

label: section
text: Element 4: Data Preservation, Access, and Associated Timelines:

label: subsection
text: A. Repository where scientific data and metadata will be archived:

label: content
text: De-identified data will be uploaded to the University of California San Diego Library repository.

label: subsection
text: B. How scientific data will be findable and identifiable:

label: content
text: Data will be findable via publications and on our project’s GitHub website, hosted as part of the UCSD

label: content
text: Advance Data Analytics Lab GitHub and titled “Deep Postures”.

label: subsection
text: C. When and how long the scientific data will be made available:

label: content
text: The research community will have access to data when the main outcome manuscript has been published.

label: content
text: $2,500 in years 2-5 of the project has been budgeted for preparing the data that is able to be stored in the

label: content
text: repository (the RISE study, the iWATCH study, and NHANES) and for data storage on the University of

label: subsection
text: California San Diego Library repository.

label: content
text: We anticipate data being available for the foreseeable future

label: section
text: Element 5: Access, Distribution, or Reuse Considerations:

label: subsection
text: A. Factors affecting subsequent access, distribution, or reuse of scientific data:

label: content
text: The following studies have independent data use agreement & approved paper proposal processes for use

label: content
text: of their data that are specific to each institution that collected the data: (i) the SOL-VIDA Study, (ii) the

label: content
text: MOCA Study, (iii) the PHASE Study, (iv) the AusDiab Study, (v) the ACT Study, and (vi) the WHISH

label: content
text: accelerometer sub-study such as data use agreements or approved publication proposals.

label: subsection
text: B. Whether access to scientific data will be controlled:

label: content
text: The final dataset of data from the RISE study, the iWATCH study, and NHANES cohorts will be de-identified.

label: section
text: Protections for privacy, rights, and confidentiality of human research participants:

label: content
text: All data used in this study was de-identified prior to use.

label: section
text: Element 6: Oversight of Data Management and Sharing:

label: content
text: The PI and Trial & IRB Coordinator will provide updates and changes to the plan in the annual RPPR.
